lines.trans: I received a message from Julien Doré.
What does he say in his message?
He thinks that the songs are not suitable.
That is a pity, I really liked this project.
Wait, there is a second sentence!
He wants you to act in his movie.
He wants me to be the lead actress?
Yes, and that you compose the music too.
But Charlotte Le Bon was supposed to have this role!
I will call him to check this proposal.
Julien confirms to me that the role is for you.
He says that you have immense talent.
It is an incredible opportunity for my career.
You worked hard to get here.
You fully deserve this lead role.
Gabriel, we must celebrate this news!

examples.text: Tu n'aimais pas Mandelieu? C'est un bel endroit.
examples.trans: Didn't you like Mandelieu? It's a lovely place.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: aller + infinitive: tu vas l'agacer = you're going to annoy her
ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Appelle Clémentine. Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
examples.trans: Call Clémentine. Tell her I can't come tonight.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = can I call you?

examples.text: Non, je viens d'arriver. Mon père, mais c'est compliqué.
examples.trans: No, I've just arrived. My dad, but it's complicated.

meanings.note: je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived

examples.text: Tu déjeunes aussi avec Dany Boon.
examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon.

examples.text: Tu déjeunes aussi avec Dany Boon demain.
examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon tomorrow.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: avoir peur = to be afraid, avoir raison = to be right, avoir 40 ans = to be 40
elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

examples.text: Tu connais beaucoup de monde dans le cinéma. Tu pourrais m'aider.
examples.trans: You know lots of people in film. You could help me.

meanings.note: beaucoup de + noun, with no article: beaucoup de travail

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

examples.text: Oui, trois cent mille. Je parle de ses vingt ans de carrière.
examples.trans: Yes, three hundred thousand. I'm talking about his twenty years of career.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Tu aimais une belle chanson. Celle-là surtout.
examples.trans: You loved a beautiful song. This one most of all.

meanings.en: to compose (music, text); to dial (phone number)
meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Prefix 'com-' (from Latin 'cum') means 'with, together'. Core French verb meaning 'to compose, to dial'.

examples.text: Oui, et que tu composes la musique aussi.
examples.trans: Yes, and that you compose the music too.

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Prefix 'con-'/'com-' (from Latin 'cum') means 'with, together'. Core French verb meaning 'to confirm'.

examples.text: Julien me confirme que le rôle est pour toi.
examples.trans: Julien confirms to me that the role is for you.

meanings.note: convenir à quelqu'un = to suit someone

examples.text: Elle conviendrait bien pour ta comédie musicale.
examples.trans: She would suit your musical well.

examples.text: Il pense que les chansons ne conviennent pas.
examples.trans: He thinks that the songs are not suitable.

examples.text: Tu connais beaucoup de monde dans le cinéma. Tu pourrais m'aider.
examples.trans: You know lots of people in film. You could help me.

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: je n'ai pas de temps; also before a plural adjective: de mauvaises nouvelles

examples.text: Norman, il faut passer en deuxième.
examples.trans: Norman, you must shift into second gear.
I have to see the play.

examples.text: Magali, je dois voir la pièce de Koltès cette semaine.
examples.trans: Magali, I have to see the Koltès play this week.

meanings.note: dire la vérité à quelqu'un = to tell someone the truth

examples.trans: It's a real shame about Cécile.

meanings.en: c'est dommage = it's a shame, what a pity

examples.text: Je comprends. C'est un coup dur.
examples.trans: I understand. It's a real blow.

meanings.note: physically hard, or hard to bear

examples.text: C'est le prochain film de Tarantino.
On fête son anniversaire ce soir.
examples.trans: We are celebrating her birthday tonight.

examples.text: Camille m'a beaucoup aidé sur une affaire délicate cette semaine. Et on fête ça.
examples.trans: Camille helped me a lot on a delicate matter this week. And we're celebrating that.

examples.text: Laissez vos photos et votre CV ici.
examples.trans: Leave your photos and your CV here.

meanings.note: for masculine nouns, and in impersonal phrases: il y a
Prefix 'im-' marks negation ('un-, im-') or inward motion.

examples.text: Pourquoi? C'est une immense star du cinéma.
examples.trans: Why? She is an immense movie star.

examples.text: Il dit que tu as un talent immense.
examples.trans: He says that you have immense talent.
You came! I can't believe it!

meanings.note: c'est incroyable! = I can't believe it! / it's amazing!

examples.text: Gabriel! Je suis à mon cours d'équitation.
examples.trans: Gabriel! I'm at my horse-riding lesson.

examples.text: Il joue le frère de Guillaume.

meanings.note: jouer un rôle, jouer le frère de...
jouer au foot, jouer du piano
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille

examples.text: Désolé pour tes messages. J'ai été très occupé.
examples.trans: Sorry about your messages. I've been very busy.

examples.text: Elle prend des cours de musique ancienne!
Elle dit toujours: oui, j'adore la musique de Bach!
examples.trans: She always says: yes, I love Bach's music!

meanings.note: écouter de la musique = to listen to music; la musique ancienne = early music

examples.text: Il le mérite après huit ans!
examples.trans: He deserves it after eight years!

examples.text: Il le mérite après huit ans à me fatiguer!
examples.trans: He deserves it after eight years of tiring me out!

meanings.en: to deserve, to merit, to be worth
meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Core French verb meaning 'to deserve, to merit'.
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
Feminine abstract noun formed with '-ité' (from Latin '-itas', English '-ity'). Standard feminine noun meaning 'opportunity'.

examples.text: C'est une opportunité incroyable pour ma carrière.
examples.trans: It is an incredible opportunity for my career.

examples.text: Oui, oui. J'ai juste besoin d'un petit cours.
examples.trans: Yes, yes. I just need a little lesson.

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Ils ont pensé que c'était mieux.

meanings.note: je pense que... = I think that...

meanings.en: je le pense: I mean it

examples.text: Attends, il y a une deuxième phrase!
examples.trans: Wait, there is a second sentence!

meanings.note: Manner adverb formed by adding '-ment' (from Latin 'mente', 'with a ... mind') to the feminine adjective stem.

examples.text: Tu mérites pleinement ce premier rôle.
examples.trans: You fully deserve this lead role.

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
C'est comme un rêve pour moi.
examples.trans: It's like a dream for me.

meanings.note: before an infinitive: pour faire plaisir

examples.text: Tes premières vacances en huit ans!
examples.trans: Your first holiday in eight years!

examples.text: Le premier jour, tu as vu Mathias avant Andréa. Donc tu le connais!
examples.trans: On the first day, you saw Mathias before Andréa. So you know him!

meanings.note: goes before the noun: les premières vacances

examples.text: Vous êtes toujours sûr pour le rôle principal féminin?
examples.trans: Are you still sure about the female lead?

meanings.note: le rôle principal = the lead role

examples.text: Tu as des projets ce soir?
Mais Cécile n'est plus dans le projet.
examples.trans: But Cécile isn't in the project any more.

meanings.note: Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Standard feminine noun meaning 'proposal, offer'.

examples.text: Je vais l'appeler pour vérifier cette proposition.
examples.trans: I will call him to check this proposal.

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.
Appelle Clémentine. Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
examples.trans: Call Clémentine. Tell her I can't come tonight.

examples.text: Je vais voir si elle peut vous recevoir.
examples.trans: I'll see if she can see you.

meanings.note: elle peut vous recevoir = she can see you

examples.text: Oui! Mon préféré, Pierre Niney, a un nouveau rôle.
examples.trans: Yes! My favourite, Pierre Niney, has a new part.

meanings.en: part, role (in a film or play)

examples.text: Oui, trois cent mille. Je parle de ses vingt ans de carrière.
examples.trans: Yes, three hundred thousand. I'm talking about his twenty years of career.

meanings.note: agrees with the thing owned, not the owner

examples.text: Oui, Quentin a beaucoup de talent.
examples.trans: Yes, Quentin has a lot of talent.

meanings.note: avoir du talent = to be talented
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi

examples.text: Cannes? Tu as travaillé au festival?
examples.trans: Cannes? Did you work at the festival?

meanings.note: travailler à Paris, travailler le dimanche
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir

examples.text: Pour vérifier mes costumes et mes notes de frais.
examples.trans: To check my suits and my expense claims.

examples.text: Pour vérifier mes costumes et mes notes de frais. Bonne chance!
examples.trans: To check my suits and my expense claims. Good luck!

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Core French verb meaning 'to check, to verify'.

examples.text: S'il vous plaît. Il n'y a rien entre Mathias et moi, d'accord?
examples.trans: Please. There's nothing between Mathias and me, okay?

meanings.note: il y a = there is / there are
j'y pense = I think about it
